p1.original: 1.诚实地表达自己，而不批评、指责
p1.en: 1. To express themselves honestly without criticism or criticism

p3.original: 我所观察（看、听、回忆、想）到的有助于（或无助于）我的福祉的具体行为：
p3.en: Specific actions that I have observed (see, hear, remember, think) that contribute (or do not contribute) to my well-being:

p4.original: “当我（看、听、想到我看到的/听到的） ……”
p4.en: "When I look, listen, think of what I see/hear..."

p6.original: 对于这些行为，我有什么样的感受（情感而非思想）：
p6.en: What do I feel about these acts (emotionals, not ideas):

p9.original: 什么样的需要或价值（而非偏好或某种具体的行为）导致我那样的感受：
p9.en: What kind of need or value (not preference or a specific act) leads me to feel that way:

p12.original: 清楚地请求（而非命令）那些能丰富我生命的具体行为，
p12.en: I am not sure if I am going to be able to do this, but I am not going to do it.

p14.original: 2.关切地倾听他人，而不解读为批评或指责
p14.en: 2. Listening with concern, without being interpreted as critical or accusing

p16.original: 你所观察（看、听、回忆、想）到的有助于（或无助于）你的福祉的具体行为：
p16.en: The specific actions you observe (see, hear, remember, think) that contribute (or do not contribute) to your well-being:

p17.original: “当你（看、听、想到你看到的/听到的） ……”
p17.en: "when you (see, hear, think of what you see/hear)..."

p19.original: 对于这些行为，你有什么样的感受（是情感而非思想）：
p19.en: How do you feel about these acts (emotional rather than ideological):

p22.original: 什么样的需要或价值（而非偏好或某种具体的行为）导致你那样的感受：
p22.en: What needs or values (rather than preferences or some specific behaviour) lead you to feel that way:

p25.original: 关切地倾听那些能丰富你生命的具体请求，而不解读为命令：
p25.en: Listening with concern to specific requests that enrich your life, without interpreting them as orders:
